# Before pack — Labs 1–6 as first written

**Do not edit anything in this folder.** These are frozen copies of Labs 1–6 exactly as the team first wrote them, kept so the Lab 4 cleanup (Labs 1–3) and the Lab 10 comparison (Lab 5) can be compared against the originals.

| Folder | Lab | What it holds | Restored from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lab1/` | Lab 1 | `loyalty.md` before the name index was tightened — long container names carrying product labels, only three constraints | commit `880aa19` |
| `lab2/` | Lab 2 | The original requirements pack spread across twelve files: five FR docs, five AS docs, the domain model, and the traceability matrix | commit `6b0e756` |
| `lab3/` | Lab 3 | The Lab 3 specification as it was first written — embedded inside the implementation folder's README rather than standing alone | commit `6b0e756` |
| `lab5/` | Lab 5 | UML before-pack sitting: four I-11 sequences (PlantUML), one activity (Mermaid), one `RedemptionOrder` state machine (Mermaid), and the G6 planning checklist. Current messy style, no Guide, no RACI | frozen snapshot |
| `lab6/` | Lab 6 | Ecosystem sketch (Mermaid): gateway, event bus, databases as I-4 containers with sync/async edge labels, product label note, and negative evidence. No Guide, no RACI | frozen snapshot |

The cleaned versions of Labs 1–3 live at the repository root: `loyalty.md`, `lab2-requirements.md`, `lab3-spec.md`.

Lab 5 and Lab 6 root copies (`lab-05-uml-before.md`, `lab-06-ecosystem-before.md`) are the working versions. The copies in this folder are the archive snapshots.

What changed between the messy and cleaned Labs 1–3 is written up in `../lab4-cleanup.md`.
What changed between Lab 5 (messy) and Lab 10 (after) is written up in the Lab 10 comparison note in `../lab-10-uml-after.md`.
